name: shell-unwrap
description: Applies shell permission rules to wrapped commands, as an OpenCode plugin, a Pi extension, and Claude Code, Codex and Cursor hooks

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && bun run build && bun test
scripts.build: bun build src/opencode.ts --target bun --outfile dist/opencode/shell-unwrap.js && bun build src/hook.ts --target bun --outfile dist/hook/shell-unwrap.js && bun build src/pi.ts --target node --outfile dist/pi/index.js
